decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed two-storey side extension and single storey rear extension
because of its position, design and appearance would not harm neighbours' living conditions, the appearance of the area or highway safety. The development complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and 1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments.) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 4 - The external walls of the extension shall be finished in red/brown sand faced brickwork or such other materials as shall be first submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The roof shall be in tiles to match the existing house

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.
Condition : 6 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 29 Prospect Close.

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a part two storey side extension and a single storey rear extension
